<infobox theme="Battle300">
        <data source="relatedevents"><label>Related events</label></data>	
        <data source="proposedby"><label>Proposed by</label></data>	
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header></header>	
        <data source="dateproposed"><label>Date</label></data>	
        <data source="government"><label>Government</label></data>
        <data source="legislativebody"><label>Legislative body</label></data>	
        <data source="result"><label>Outcome</label></data>
    </group>
    <group layout="horizontal">
    	<header></header>
        <data source="side1"><label>Support</label></data>	
        <data source="side2"><label>Opposition</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">	
        <data source="otherkeyindividuals"><label>Other key individuals</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Law|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<noinclude>[[category:Event infobox templates]]{{clear}}
===See also===
* For two-, three-, and four-way battles, use [[Template:Battle]]
* For wars or other conflicts, use [[Template:War]]
* For missions, use [[Template:Mission]]
* For duels, use [[Template:Duel]]
* For campaigns, use [[Template:Campaign]]
* For general events, use [[Template:Event]]


===Usage===
To use this template, paste the following code into the top of the article, filling all relevant fields:
<pre><nowiki>
{{Law
|relatedevents=
|proposedby=
|image=
|name=
|dateproposed=
|government=
|legislativebody=
|result=
|side1=
|side2=
|otherkeyindividuals=
}}
</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
